about: 52-week SmartHerd plan. Each teaching week is one lesson with 3 sessions: S1 Learn, S2 Build, S3 Submit. Buffer weeks are skipped by the daily task. Source: the SmartHerd Learning Path plan (Claude doc).

weeks.title: Electricity, parts and your first circuit
weeks.learn: Voltage, current, resistance, Ohm's law, circuits, LED, resistor, push button, breadboard, ESP32 power pins
weeks.build: Button-controlled LED in Wokwi, no code
weeks.submit: Wokwi link, concept answers, Ohm's law and colour-code problems

weeks.title: Every ESP32 pin, and your first code
weeks.learn: Every ESP32-DevKitC pin: GPIO numbers, input-only pins 34-39, strapping pins (0, 2, 12, 15), flash pins to avoid, ADC pins, TX/RX, EN/Boot. What a program is: setup(), loop(), Serial.begin/println, baud rate, delay()
weeks.build: Redo the earlier labs properly in Wokwi: Hello message, LED on GPIO 2 with pinMode/digitalWrite, button on GPIO 4 with INPUT_PULLUP, then print once per press (edge detection with a lastState variable and debounce)
weeks.submit: Code, Serial Monitor output, an explanation of each line, and why INPUT_PULLUP reads LOW when pressed

weeks.title: Git, Docker and your own tracking server (Track A)
weeks.learn: Git and GitHub basics, Docker basics, Linux refresh: systemd, ufw
weeks.build: Install Docker at home or on a VPS, run Traccar, track your phone with the Traccar Client app, set a geofence with a Telegram alert
weeks.submit: Checkpoint: your phone on your own map plus a Telegram alert when you leave the zone

weeks.title: Your real board
weeks.learn: Matching a real board's printed labels to its pin diagram, data vs charge-only USB cables, USB drivers (CP2102 or CH340), choosing board and port in Arduino IDE, multimeter volts and continuity
weeks.build: Blink a real LED on a real ESP32, measure 3.3 V and 5 V pins, find a real button's pin pairs with continuity mode
weeks.submit: Wiring photo, meter readings, your board's pin map

weeks.title: Non-blocking code, analog input and PWM
weeks.learn: millis() instead of delay(), analog input (ADC), PWM
weeks.build: Dim an LED with a potentiometer while another LED blinks on its own timer
weeks.submit: Code with no delay() and why that matters

weeks.title: Talking to sensors: UART and I2C
weeks.learn: Serial protocols UART and I2C, libraries, I2C addresses
weeks.build: Read the MPU6050 accelerometer, print x, y, z, tilt it and watch
weeks.submit: Output while still vs moving, and what I2C addresses are

weeks.title: GPS
weeks.build: Wire the NEO-6M and get a fix outdoors with TinyGPS++
weeks.submit: Lat, long, satellite count and HDOP from outside your house

weeks.title: Temperature, JSON and a buzzer
weeks.build: Add a DS18B20 probe and a buzzer, output one JSON line per reading
weeks.submit: One clean JSON line holding GPS, motion and temperature

weeks.title: Soldering and storing data
weeks.learn: Soldering safely, perfboard layout, microSD storage
weeks.build: Solder header pins, move the circuit to perfboard, log JSON to SD
weeks.submit: Close-up photos of joints and an SD log with 50+ lines

weeks.title: Power, batteries and deep sleep
weeks.learn: mAh, current draw, deep sleep, safe 18650 charging
weeks.build: Measure current awake vs asleep, run from an 18650 with a TP4056
weeks.submit: Measured mA figures and estimated battery hours

weeks.title: Checkpoint: handheld GPS logger
weeks.build: Battery-powered logger recording position and motion every 30 s to SD; walk a route and plot it on geojson.io
weeks.submit: Checkpoint: route on a map plus a one-page write-up of what went wrong

weeks.title: Cellular basics
weeks.learn: 2G vs 4G, LTE Cat-1, APN, AT commands, why 2G is a dead end
weeks.build: Register a 4G ESP32 board on MTN or Telecel; caretaker checks signal at the farm
weeks.submit: AT command log showing registration and a farm signal report

weeks.title: MQTT
weeks.learn: HTTP vs MQTT, publish/subscribe, topics, QoS
weeks.build: Run Mosquitto in Docker, ESP32 publishes test data over Wi-Fi
weeks.submit: mosquitto_sub output showing the device's messages

weeks.title: Store and forward over 4G
weeks.learn: What to do with no signal, Traccar's OsmAnd protocol
weeks.build: Publish GPS over 4G, buffer offline readings and send later
weeks.submit: Log showing offline readings delivered after reconnecting

weeks.title: Saving telemetry in Postgres
weeks.build: Python paho-mqtt subscriber writes every message to Postgres
weeks.submit: Schema plus a SELECT showing 100+ rows

weeks.title: Geofences with PostGIS
weeks.build: Draw a paddock, check points in SQL, Telegram alert when outside
weeks.submit: Geofence query and alert screenshot

weeks.title: Dashboards with Grafana
weeks.learn: Data sources, map panels, alert rules
weeks.build: Dashboard with live map, battery and activity
weeks.submit: Dashboard screenshot

weeks.title: A small API with FastAPI
weeks.build: API to register animals and devices
weeks.submit: Swagger page screenshot plus a curl test

weeks.title: Checkpoint: a day on 4G
weeks.build: Tracker rides in your car or bag for a full day over 4G
weeks.submit: Checkpoint: the day on the Grafana map, a geofence alert, comparison with the Traccar track

weeks.title: Threat modelling
weeks.build: Data flow diagram of SmartHerd and what an attacker could want
weeks.submit: Diagram plus top 5 threats

weeks.title: Think like an attacker
weeks.build: Capture your own plain MQTT traffic and find the password; scan your own server
weeks.submit: Captured credential (then changed) plus nmap report

weeks.title: Encrypting the pipeline
weeks.learn: TLS and certificates, per-device accounts, ACLs
weeks.build: MQTT over TLS, one login per device, firewall locked down, fail2ban
weeks.submit: Wireshark capture showing only encrypted traffic

weeks.title: Securing the device
weeks.learn: ESP32 secure boot, flash encryption, handling secrets
weeks.build: Practise on a spare board only (permanent eFuse settings)
weeks.submit: Write-up of what each setting protects against

weeks.title: Safe over-the-air updates
weeks.build: Push an update over the network; make a bad update roll back
weeks.submit: OTA log showing both cases

weeks.title: Monitoring and backups
weeks.build: Send server logs to Wazuh, alert on brute force, back up and restore the database
weeks.submit: Triggered alert plus proof the restore worked

weeks.title: Checkpoint: pentest and harden
weeks.build: Pentest your own system, then harden it
weeks.submit: Checkpoint: before and after security report, 3 to 5 pages

weeks.title: Power budgets
weeks.learn: What each part draws and for how long
weeks.build: Measure each component; battery life at 1, 5 and 15 minute reporting
weeks.submit: Power budget table and chosen interval

weeks.title: Solar charging
weeks.build: A small panel charging the battery in the sun for a week, logging voltage
weeks.submit: 7-day battery voltage chart

weeks.title: Enclosure and collar
weeks.learn: Enclosures, IP ratings, cable glands, heat
weeks.build: Fit everything into an IP65+ box on a strap; 3-hour sun test
weeks.submit: Photos, total weight, internal temperature after the heat test

weeks.title: Animal welfare and the caretaker
weeks.learn: Animal welfare, working with a caretaker
weeks.build: Vet input on collar fit and weight; daily check routine with the caretaker
weeks.submit: Signed-off fit checklist and a one-page caretaker guide

weeks.title: Field trial 1
weeks.build: 7 days on the cow next to the Track A tracker, same strap if the vet agrees
weeks.submit: Daily notes from you and the caretaker

weeks.title: Reading results honestly
weeks.build: Compare accuracy, battery curve, dropped messages vs the commercial tracker; fix the worst problem
weeks.submit: Comparison table and list of fixes

weeks.title: Checkpoint: field trial 2
weeks.build: 14-day field trial
weeks.submit: Checkpoint: trial report with uptime, battery days, accuracy, every failure

weeks.title: pandas and time series
weeks.build: Load trial data, fix gaps, resample to 5 minutes
weeks.submit: Notebook with clean data and 3 charts

weeks.title: Statistics essentials
weeks.build: Daily distance walked and hours moving
weeks.submit: Charts plus 3 things the data says about the cow's day

weeks.title: Machine learning ideas
weeks.build: Kaggle Learn Intro to Machine Learning
weeks.submit: Certificate plus 'what is overfitting?'

weeks.title: Labelling data
weeks.build: Caretaker films the cow 2-3 hours; label grazing, resting, walking against accelerometer timestamps
weeks.submit: Labelled dataset with 500+ windows

weeks.title: A behaviour classifier
weeks.learn: Feature extraction, random forests, confusion matrices
weeks.build: Train a classifier with scikit-learn
weeks.submit: Accuracy and confusion matrix with explanation

weeks.title: Anomaly detection
weeks.build: Learn the cow's normal day and flag very quiet days (prompts a check, not a diagnosis)
weeks.submit: Alert on a test quiet day

weeks.title: TinyML on the collar
weeks.build: Run a small model on the ESP32 so the collar sends behaviour summaries
weeks.submit: Model on-device plus data use before and after

weeks.title: A weekly AI report
weeks.build: Sunday plain-English summary of the cow's week on Telegram
weeks.submit: A sample weekly report

weeks.title: Checkpoint: AI on live data
weeks.build: Classifier, anomaly alerts and weekly report running for 7 days
weeks.submit: Checkpoint evidence for all three

weeks.title: Actuators
weeks.learn: Relays, DC motors, servos, motor drivers; 12 V only, mains to an electrician
weeks.build: Drive a servo and a 12 V pump through a relay
weeks.submit: Video plus wiring diagram

weeks.title: Control loops
weeks.learn: On/off with hysteresis, what PID is
weeks.build: Water trough controller on the bench with dry alert
weeks.submit: Test log showing no rapid flicker

weeks.title: Computer vision
weeks.learn: Raspberry Pi or laptop, OpenCV, a pretrained detector
weeks.build: Count animals in photos or video
weeks.submit: Detection results on 20 farm images

weeks.title: Goat pen or poultry module
weeks.build: Temperature/humidity plus fan control on the same pipeline
weeks.submit: New device on the same dashboard

weeks.title: Robotics intro
weeks.build: A 2-wheel rover that avoids obstacles
weeks.submit: Video plus explanation of the control loop

weeks.title: Securing new devices
weeks.build: Run every new device through the checklist
weeks.submit: Updated security report

weeks.title: Checkpoint: an actuator at the farm
weeks.build: One working actuator system at the farm
weeks.submit: Checkpoint: demo plus a one-page plan for goats or poultry

weeks.title: Year review
weeks.build: Decide Year 2: virtual fencing research, LoRaWAN, certifications
weeks.submit: A short Year 2 plan
